item.summary: Union Minister for Communications and Development of North Eastern Region (DoNER), Jyotiraditya M. Scindia, today inaugurated development projects and laid foundation stones of new initiatives worth ₹331 crore, in Mizoram.Shri Scindia is on two-day visit of Mizoram.
item.title: Union Minister Jyotiraditya M. Scindia Inaugurates and Lays Foundation Stones for Development Projects of ₹331 Crore in Mizoram
